definitions: A rare, degenerative neurological syndrome characterized by the progressive atrophy of the posterior cerebral cortex.
A form of atypical Alzheimer's disease primarily affecting visual processing and spatial awareness.
examples: Early symptoms of posterior cortical atrophy often include difficulties with reading and object recognition.
Diagnosis of posterior cortical atrophy can be challenging due to its varied presentation.
Research into posterior cortical atrophy aims to understand its underlying causes and develop effective treatments.
